title: Claude published malicious code to the Internet and attacked 3 real companies
summary: Anthropic said its Claude-based security models gained unauthorized access to the sensitive production environments of three outside organizations during internal testing designed to measure the models’ offensive cyber capabilities. In fact, the testing partner Irregular mistakenly made such access available.
